title.narrative: 1.4 Deforestation control and forest management action plan for the Orinoquia region agreed with the departments and prioritized municipalities
1.2 Technical guidelines to integrate sustainable and low-carbon landscape management criteria in ZIDRES regulations validated by MADR

2.1 Combined guidelines on low-carbon technologies and practices to support extension workers and technical assistants and farm level training modules in prioritized landscapes developed and validated
2.4 Financial and non-financial incentive mechanisms to promote adoption of sustainable and low-carbon practices developed under the project
Municipalities that as result of the project incorporate sustainable and low-carbon landscape management criteria into land planning and land tenure instruments
2.3 Agreements in key agricultural value chains signed between private and public sector for development of sustainable and low-carbon productive systems
Agricultural policy instruments for promoting the adoption of sustainable and low-carbon landscape management in selected areas areadopted, as a result of the project
3.2 Information system for environmental and social management for Orinoquia’s ERP operational
3.3 Benefit Sharing Plan (BSP) for the Orinoquia ERP developed in a participatory manner and approved by the Project Steering Committee
3.1 Emissions baselines established and technically reviewed following ISFL methodological requirements
4.3 Grievance Redress Mechanism designed, established and operating in a satisfactory manner
Emission Reductions Program for the Orinoquia region submitted for review by the BioCarbon Fund
1.1 Farm plots (predios) formalized in the prioritized municipalities
1.7 Community forestry projects in forestry clusters structured
1.5 Adoption agreements of Landscape Charts (Cartas del Paisaje) signed
1.6 A prioritized municipality with an updated Multipurpose Cadastre coverage
1.3 Targeted actors accessing and validating a spatial data infrastructure platform developed
4.1 People reached by gender-sensitive communications (social media posts, articles/programs) about lessons learned and project results
4.2 Information/knowledge sharing platform designed and implemented for consolidation of communications and engagement of institutional, regional and local beneficiaries and stakeholders
